title: Where is x, y?
summary: Every spot on the stage has an x and a y. Send characters to corners, glide them across, and make one meet another.
learn: Find a spot with x (left and right) and y (up and down)
Move to x y, and set just x or just y
Glide from one spot to another
Go to where another sprite is

chapters.title: Guide
chapters.idea: The ideas, one at a time

finish.text: You can send sprites anywhere on the stage!
remix: Make Bee fly around all four corners.
Make Robot go to wherever Fox is when you press space.

steps.title: Play first
steps.text: Press [[Run code]] and tap the game. Press 1, 2, 3 and 4 to send Fox to the corners. Tap Robot. Press [space] for Bee.

checklist.text: Press [[Run code]], then the number keys

steps.why: Every spot on the <<stage>> has two numbers: <<x>> for left and right, <<y>> for up and down.

steps.title: The middle is 0, 0
steps.text: Tap Robot and it runs ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Robot to x 0 y 0)).

predict.question: You tap Robot. Where does Robot go?
predict.explain: x 0 and y 0 is the very middle of the stage.

steps.title: x is left and right
steps.text: The stage goes from x -240 on the left to x 240 on the right. Press 1 and Fox runs ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Fox to x 200 y 0)).

predict.question: You press 1. Where is Fox?
predict.explain: x 200 is far to the right. Minus x would be left.

steps.title: y is up and down
steps.text: The stage goes from y -160 at the bottom to y 160 at the top. Press 2 and Fox runs ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Fox to x 0 y -120)).

predict.question: You press 2. Where is Fox?
predict.explain: y -120 is far down. Plus y is up, minus y is down.

steps.title: Send Robot to a corner
steps.coach: Move to x y is in Motion. Tap it!
steps.text: When you tap Robot, send it to the top left corner: x -180, y 110.

checklist.text: Put ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Robot to x -180 y 110)) under it

hints: Pick Robot under the stage, then drag ((Events#hat:click|when Robot clicked)) out of {{Events}}.
Under it, ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Robot to x -180 y 110)). Left is minus x, top is plus y.

steps.title: Which corner?
steps.text: Think of the stage: x is left and right, y is up and down.

quiz.question: Which part of the stage is x 150, y 100?
quiz.explain: Plus x is right, plus y is up: the top right.

quiz.question: Which part of the stage is x -150, y -100?
quiz.explain: Minus x is left, minus y is down: the bottom left.

quiz.question: Which part of the stage is x -150, y 100?
quiz.explain: Minus x is left, plus y is up: the top left.

steps.title: Snap it in
steps.text: Snap the loose move block under ((Events#hat:click|when Fox clicked)), so a tap sends Fox to the middle.

script.label: Tap Fox: Fox goes to x 0, y 0

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Drag the move block by its left edge and drop it under the when block.

steps.title: Robot moves
steps.text: When you tap Robot, Robot moves to x 100, y 50.

script.label: Tap Robot: Robot is at x 100, y 50

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Use ((Events#hat:click|when Robot clicked)) and ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Robot to x 100 y 50)).

quiz.question: Fox moves to x 0, y 100. Which way did Fox go?
quiz.explain: Only y changed, and it got bigger: up.

quiz.question: Fox moves to x -100, y 0. Which way did Fox go?
quiz.explain: Only x changed, and it went minus: left.

quiz.question: Fox moves to x 0, y -80. Which way did Fox go?
quiz.explain: Only y changed, and it went minus: down.

steps.title: The wrong side
steps.text: Tapping Bee should send it to the left side, at x -150, y 0. But it flies to the right! Fix the number.

script.label: Tap Bee: Bee is at x -150, y 0

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

steps.title: Top first, then the middle
steps.text: Tapping Robot should send it to the top (x 0, y 120), wait a second, then bring it to the middle. The two move blocks are swapped. Put them right.

script.label: First Robot goes to the top
Then it comes to the middle

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Blocks run top to bottom. Which move should come first?
Drag the top move block below the wait, and the bottom one above it.

steps.title: Fly to the flower
steps.text: When you press [space], Bee glides to x 120, y 80 in 1 second.

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Use ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)) and ((Motion#scene_glide|glide sprite Bee for 1 seconds to x 120 y 80)).

steps.title: Set just x
steps.text: Robot is at x 120, y -40. Tapping it runs ((Motion#scene_set|set sprite Robot x to -50)).

quiz.question: You tap Robot. Where is it now?
quiz.explain: Set x changes only x. y stays -40.

variants.text: Robot is at x 120, y -40. Tapping it runs ((Motion#scene_set|set sprite Robot y to 0)).

quiz.question: You tap Robot. Where is it now?
quiz.explain: Set y changes only y. x stays 120.

steps.title: Meet Robot
steps.text: When you tap Fox, Fox goes to wherever Robot is, even after Robot moves. Put ((Motion#scene_get|sprite Robot x)) and ((Motion#scene_get|sprite Robot y)) into ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Fox to x … y …)).

script.label: Tap Fox: Fox goes to Robot
Robot moves to x -90, y 70: Fox follows

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Typing 120 and -40 only works while Robot stays put. ((Motion#scene_get|sprite Robot x)) reads where Robot is now.
Drag ((Motion#scene_get|sprite Robot x)) into the x hole and ((Motion#scene_get|sprite Robot y)) into the y hole. Choose y in its menu.
steps.why: A block like sprite Robot x is a question: “where is Robot now?”. Its answer can change.

steps.title: Treasure hunt
steps.text: ★ Make a treasure hunt! Send friends to different spots on the stage. Try the ideas below, then press Next step.

checklist.text: Two friends go to different spots
Someone goes to where another one is

steps.title: Show what you know: go there
steps.text: When you tap Robot, Robot moves to x -100, y 80.

script.label: Tap Robot: Robot is at x -100, y 80

variants.text: When you tap Fox, Fox moves to x 160, y -100.

script.label: Tap Fox: Fox is at x 160, y -100

steps.title: Show what you know: which spot?
steps.text: Think of the stage: x is left and right, y is up and down.

quiz.question: Which part of the stage is x 180, y -120?
quiz.explain: Plus x is right, minus y is down: the bottom right.

quiz.question: Fox is at x 0, y 0 and moves to x 0, y 140. Which way did it go?
Which part of the stage is x -170, y 110?
quiz.explain: Minus x is left, plus y is up: the top left.

steps.title: Show what you know: glide
steps.text: When you press [space], Bee glides to x -120, y 100 in 1 second.

script.label: Press space: Bee lands at x -120, y 100

variants.text: When you tap Fox, Fox goes to wherever Bee is.

script.label: Bee is at x 60, y 40: tap Fox and Fox goes there
